claim_results.claim: The repaired grouped corpus improves cloze and hard retrieval while preserving paired and retention gates

claim_results.claim: ZERO.4 Q22 operation routing survives Solomon integer class-head training under the frozen shared task

nodes.summary: The prospectively frozen Solomon run scored 500/500 on seeds 1, 2, and 3, with identical predictions across all 500 promotion cases. The narrow operation-routing bridge passed without retraining after evaluation opened.
nodes.next_boundary: Do not infer language-model or arithmetic-generation quality. Any successor must freeze a harder task that breaks prefix-only routing and tests compositional transfer.

nodes.next_boundary: Do not tune against the opened promotion set. A successor needs a new frozen surface and a representation- or objective-level change with a representation-sufficiency diagnostic.

method_assessment.verdict: The program is strong at truth preservation and experimental discipline, but weaker at maximizing information gain and controlling serial local-repair lineages.
strengths: Prospective contracts, immutable hashes, exact replay, and fail-closed gates prevent attractive partial results from becoming promotion claims.
Negative results remain first-class evidence and can close intervention families without opening hidden or downstream evaluation.
The ZERO.4 Q2.3 through Q2.6 sequence shows successful causal refinement: local budget, cumulative authority, scalar continuation, then update direction.
Surprising positive results are replicated across frozen seeds before family promotion.

The EXP-007 to EXP-008 transition shows an efficient abstraction change: a perfect prefix-separable result was challenged once on a shortcut-resistant surface and the fixed class-head boundary closed cleanly.
failure_modes: Some lineages perform serial nearest-neighbor repairs to schedules, data mixtures, or candidate selection before testing the underlying representation or direction.
Exact determinism can reproduce a low-information or surface-specific experiment perfectly.
Promotion gates are sometimes used as the only diagnostic, so a failed conjunction does not identify which causal explanation is correct.
Forecast coverage and evidence maturity are uneven across native, retro, external, private, and withheld results.
Repeated adaptive use of a public development surface can consume its decision value even while the hidden panel remains sealed.
proposed_rules: Freeze competing explanations for data, representation, objective, and optimization geometry, and require each major run to distinguish at least two.
Run cheap cross-document or cross-seed stability audits before optimizing a local surface.
After two consecutive failures within one intervention family, require a change in abstraction rather than another parameter tweak.
Keep promotion gates unchanged but add non-authoritative diagnostic measurements that identify the failed mechanism.
Track lineage-level experiment count, compute, and public-evaluation exposure budgets in addition to per-run limits.
Record scientific outcome, execution, disclosure, lifecycle, and evidence maturity as separate axes.
Require major branches to declare rules_out, supports, supersedes, and next_allowed intervention edges.
priority_order: Run a read-only representation-sufficiency diagnosis of the failed shortcut-resistant bridge before choosing a new representation- or objective-level successor on fresh evaluation templates.
Run a read-only NSRL frozen-representation sufficiency audit before another training method.
Decide whether ZERO5-C6.1 earns its separately authorized representation-level run.
Import outstanding external evidence and settle verified upstream family evidence locally.
Do not reopen closed local-coordinate, scalar-backtracking, ordinary paired-next-token, or public-proxy HRR-advantage branches without a new causal hypothesis.
